whatWeDo.question: What we do?
whatWeDo.title: From custom software to AI-driven products
whatWeDo.description: We help companies adopt AI, and we build the software that makes it usable — from the ground up when nothing exists yet, or woven into what's already there.

software.title: Web development
software.headline: We build custom web platforms
software.description: Built from scratch for a company's specific operation, not adapted from a generic template.

ai.title: AI integration
ai.headline: We build AI-powered solutions
ai.description: Helping companies adopt AI inside the services and workflows they already run — including using AI to automate the manual processes slowing them down.

data.title: Data analysis
data.headline: We build decisions grounded in data
data.description: Analyzing, cleaning, and organizing data as the foundation any real decision needs.

apps.title: App development
apps.headline: We build custom apps
apps.description: Mobile and desktop apps built around how your team actually works, not a generic template.

whoWeAre.headline: Built in the city where we grew up.
whoWeAre.body: We founded Connecta in Guatemala City to build the technology we always wished existed — for companies that deserve better than a template. Great design and state-of-the-art technology aren't features we add later; they're the standard we hold every product to, starting with our own.

design.title: Great design
design.description: Design is part of the engineering, not a finishing touch.

stateOfTheArt.title: State-of-the-art
stateOfTheArt.description: We reach for what's genuinely new, not what's safest to ship.

unique.title: Unique experiences
unique.description: Every product should feel like nothing else on the market.

medassistant.title: Software for healthcare clinics
medassistant.description: Medassistant gives doctors and clinic managers control of their operation. From billing patients, generating invoices, managing payments, to following up on appointments and patients, all in one place.

hero.subtitle: The software that would allow you to manage your clinic and make intelligent decisions. All integrated, all simple.
hero.imageAlt: Doctor using tablet in a modern and bright clinic

preview.title: Your Medical Ecosystem, Unified and Intelligent
preview.description: An interface designed for humans, powered by data. Visualize everything that matters at a glance.

visitSummaries.title: Automated Visit Summaries
visitSummaries.description: Instantly send a complete visit summary to your patient's email after the consultation. Improve patient adherence and keep them informed with a single click.

profileAccess.title: Instant Profile Access
profileAccess.description: Specific patient details are just a keystroke away. Access full history, allergies, and notes in seconds without digging through physical files.

paymentManagement.title: Flexible Payment Management
paymentManagement.description: Handle clinic finances with ease. Record full or partial payments, track outstanding balances, and manage invoices directly within the patient's file.
